title: Hire for Attitude or for Experience?

scenes.say: Lots of experience and a good hire sound like the same thing. Often they're not.
The register and steaming milk can be taught on the job. Being warm and reliable is much harder to teach.

props.fact: Skills can be taught on the job. Attitude is much harder to teach.

scenes.say: One big study of twenty thousand new hires found nearly nine in ten who failed, failed on attitude, not skill.

scenes.speaker: Maria
scenes.say: I don't know who has the most experience. I know who's kind to me.

props.name: Maria
props.quote: I don't know who's experienced. I know who's *kind*.

scenes.say: So: decide what's truly needed on day one. Ask how they'd handle a rush. And pay for a short trial shift.

props.caption: Hire *smart*
props.title: Hiring
steps: Decide what's needed on day one
Ask how they'd handle a rush
Try a short, paid trial shift
